name: Arcads
original_description:
Arcads is a creative tool for making advertising content. This plugin turns a product, a brief or a reference ad into finished ad creatives: video ads (UGC-style, cinematic short films, Pixar-style 3D, paper-collage animation, AI music and song ads), static image ads, Amazon listing images, and motion versions of existing statics.

Typical tasks: find competitor ads in the Meta Ad Library for inspiration, clone the hook of a reference video for your brand, adapt a static ad to your product, write a script or song lyrics and generate the matching video, and restyle or animate existing footage and images.

It is built for marketers, growth teams, agencies and e-commerce brands who produce ads for Meta, TikTok and other social platforms.

Limitations: an Arcads account is required, and every generation uses the credits included in that account. Competitor research needs a connected browser automation tool. Some skills stitch clips locally and need ffmpeg.
